title: Awesome Science
description: Noah Justice travels to Arches National Park and Natural Bridges National Monument in Utah where explores how catastrophic erosion has produced these incredible rock structures.  At Arches he’ll see how sediments were laid down quickly, then were eroded by water catastrophically, leaving behind these arches.  He’ll show how the simple rate of erosion should have destroyed these arches long ago if naturalism were true.

title: The Creation Case
description: Since the erosion of land is caused mostly by water and wind, how do we explain the massive amount of eroded areas of our planet? This kind of large scale erosion isn’t happening today. Did something different happen in the past to cause so much destruction? Headquarters send Rich to investigate and the evidence is catastrophic!
